# Kashan Murtaza

> Business Manager in e-commerce (eyewear and optical products), and operations and digital marketing specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan. Four years of experience across e-commerce operations, product research, social media marketing and AI content creation.

## Services
- E-commerce operations: order processing, inventory and dispatch coordination, returns and refunds, Shopify store operations
- Digital marketing: social media strategy, Meta Ads, campaign management, performance analysis
- AI content: AI-generated videos and images for ads and social media, prompt engineering
- Research: product research, market and audience research
